signature.name: VTask.Supports
signature.type: {K : Type u_1} -> {Γ : K → Type u_2} -> {Λ : Type u_3} -> {σ : Type u_4} -> [Inhabited Λ] -> (M : Λ → Turing.TM2.Stmt Γ Λ σ) -> (S : Finset Λ) -> Prop

conventions.statement: The Inhabited instance on Λ is used to require that the canonical default state belongs to S; if S does not contain this default state, VTask.Supports M S is false regardless of the instructions.
conventions.note: This is not a junk-value convention but a genuine semantic requirement: the default state plays the role of the initial state for the machine.
